retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast graphic style featuring heavy, 3D-extruded diagonal typography with gritty stipple textures and ink-splatter accents against a solid black void.
triggerTerms: gritty new wave album art style

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, minimalist composition dominated by a large, upward-slanted 3D text block. The letters feature a pink-to-red face with a white-to-grey extruded side, heavily textured with stippling and surrounded by sharp, needle-like ink splatters that suggest impact or motion.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tension between the text and the square frame
High contrast between vibrant textured type and absolute black background
Repetition of sharp splatter motifs across the letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary text runs from bottom-left to top-right, occupying approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal ascent of the main text, starting from the small vertical prefix at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive, flat black space surrounding the central graphic element.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright, textured letters and the zero-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Deep 3D extrusion angled towards the bottom-right
Rounded terminals on curves (O, C, S) mixed with sharp corners on stems
Integrated splatter marks emerging from the letter edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' contains a central black dot resembling a pupil or hole
Splatter marks act as decorative extensions of the glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured display type paired with a wide, clean, geometric secondary sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the 3D extrusion effect.
Matches the wide, blocky feel of the secondary metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background with a large, diagonal 3D block shape running from bottom-left to top-right. The shape should have a grainy, stippled texture in pink and red on the top face and white/grey on the side faces. Add sharp, needle-like black and white ink splatters around the edges of the shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy, geometric sans-serif text over the diagonal shape. Ensure the text follows the 45-degree angle. Add a secondary line of wide-tracked, small red text in the top-left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main text oriented at a 45-degree upward angle?
Does the text have a visible 3D extrusion with stipple texture?
Are there ink splatter effects around the letter edges?
Is the background a flat, solid black?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast stipple grain on the 3D faces.
Ensure the ink splatters look sharp and intentional, not like digital noise.
Verify the secondary text is widely tracked and positioned in the corner.
Confirm the background is pure black without gradients.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a heavy geometric sans-serif, extrude it 45 degrees downward, apply a grainy airbrush texture to the faces, and place it diagonally on a black void with sharp ink-blot accents.
